description: This file defines a Krisp noise reduction audio filter for the Pipecat project, implementing real-time noise suppression using Krisp's SDK. It includes classes for managing KrispProcessor instances and applying the filter to audio frames, along with handling deprecation warnings.

classes.name: KrispProcessorManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing KrispAudioProcessor instances, ensuring only one exists.

classes.name: KrispFilter
classes.description: Audio filter class utilizing Krisp noise reduction technology to process audio streams.

methods.description: Handles control frames to enable or disable filtering.
